profile.name: AA Opto MDS 声光可调滤波器
profile.name_en: AA Opto MDS Acousto-Optic Tunable Filter
profile.description: 这是一台 AA Opto 的 MDS 系列声光可调滤波器/控制单元，用于按通道控制激光光路的透过、射频驱动功率和工作频率，从而实现特定波长或光束的快速选通与强度调节。该设备常用于荧光显微、激光扫描和多激光实验中的快速波长选择与光强调制。
profile.description_en: This is an AA Opto MDS-series acousto-optic tunable filter and controller used to control laser transmission, RF drive power, and operating frequency on individual channels, enabling fast wavelength selection and intensity modulation. It is commonly used in fluorescence microscopy, laser scanning, and multi-laser laboratory setups for rapid optical switching and beam control.

AA Opto MDS Acousto-Optic Tunable Filter
这是一台 AA Opto 的 MDS 系列声光可调滤波器/控制单元，用于按通道控制激光光路的透过、射频驱动功率和工作频率，从而实现特定波长或光束的快速选通与强度调节。该设备常用于荧光显微、激光扫描和多激光实验中的快速波长选择与光强调制。

This is an AA Opto MDS-series acousto-optic tunable filter and controller used to control laser transmission, RF drive power, and operating frequency on individual channels, enabling fast wavelength selection and intensity modulation. It is commonly used in fluorescence microscopy, laser scanning, and multi-laser laboratory setups for rapid optical switching and beam control.
